notes: Datasheet title part L9-SC553101-20PPC: 1550 nm FP, -10~70℃, 20 km, Simplex SC, Rx S <-32 dBm, Tx P -15~-8 dBm. Ordering also lists L9-SC315501 variants (1310 nm) and -20PPI (-40~85℃). Recommended operating data rate 155.52 Mbps; features state up to 155 Mbps. Launch power, sensitivity, and max input power notes reference 20 km. Absolute maximum operating temperature TC 0~70℃; recommended TC 0~70℃, TI -40~85℃. Storage -40~85℃. Supply Vcc 3.14~3.47 V (typ 3.3 V); Icc max 250 mA. Output spectrum width Δλ max 4 nm (FP-LD). Optical rise/fall time max 2.0 ns (20%-80%). Eye diagram per ITU-T G.957 STM-1/OC-3. Signal detect (SD) low when no light.
provenance_datasheet_sections: Dimensions: Simplex SC receptacle optical interface
